lines.text: Tycho wakes on the floor of his own home.
What? What just happened? Was this a dream? How am I alive?
... No, it wasn't a dream, I still have the etchings. I might still be dreaming though. Let me check real quick.
Not a dream. I cannot breathe through my pinched nose, which should be possible in a dream. All other data points also point in the direction of this being reality.
Let me check in with my sister, maybe we can find out what is happening here. And maybe we can take advantage of it
He finds Sophia at her workbench, bent over her instruments.

Sophia! Sorry to interrupt your work, but this might be of interest to you too. While out in the fields, I fell into a cave, touched some foreign object, got some etchings and seemingly power, entered a portal, was slain by monsters, woke up here again. It was not a dream, you can see the etchings on my arm for yourself.
What are you talking about? I might think you went insane, but I see your forearms, which give some credibility to your story. Show me what you found, you can explain on the way
So here was the object, it dissolved after I touched it and opened this portal.
This goes against my every theory I had about how the world actually works. But maybe it runs on divine energy after all? On magic? I need to see this for myself
Sophia steps toward the portal. It does not let her through.

I cannot go through. Probably keyed to you, as it got created at the same time as your etchings. What a shame. Well, you are the one out in the field anyway. Make sure to bring back as much as you can. We want to study this.
Sure will do. Probably better that only I can enter, as it's quite dangerous in there. I feel like the artefact will resurrect me again if I should fail, so this is the safest way.
This is something huge and something completely unknown to us. It is imperative that you continue researching it, and bring back everything you can find
Did not have anything else in mind.
